newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Van Leer builds steel drum plant in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Van Leer builds steel drum plant in Japan.

text.p: Dutch packaging group Van Leer said on Wednesday it would start construction of a new steel drum factory near Nagoya in Japan in January 1997.
Van Leer will invest 41 million guilders in the project which will be its first manufacturing plant in Japan.
The plant will operate under the name of Nippon-Van Leer and will have a production capacity of one million drums per year.
Van Leer said the new plant will enable it to supply its Japanese customers locally and to complete its global supply network. The plant is expected to be completed in December 1997.
Van Leer said it plans to develop other industrial containers and packaging materials in Japan in the near future.
